integrity: The proof reconstructs the focal source's exact pre-simplification inequality and independently verifies the new monotonicity step. No numerical experiment is used as proof.
limitations: Necessary lower-bound obstruction only; no exact value of \(k_0(\ell_p)\) is claimed, and the proof is restricted to \(1<p\le2\).
title: A sharper scalar obstruction for \(\ell_p\) ball-to-sphere Lipschitz retractions
